name: marketplace-creator
description: Generates a valid Anthropic Claude Code plugin marketplace manifest (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json) from user input or an existing repository layout.

usage.trigger: Invoke when the user wants to create, scaffold, or update a Claude Code plugin marketplace, distribute plugins to a team or organization, or needs help with marketplace.json structure or plugin source types.
examples: Create a marketplace.json for our internal Claude plugins
Add a new plugin to our existing marketplace
What plugin source type should I use for a monorepo?

input.description: Marketplace name, owner info, and list of plugins with their source locations (repo URLs, paths, npm package names). Optionally an existing marketplace.json to update.

output.description: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json file with validated JSON. Summary of marketplace name, owner, plugin count, and source types used.
